title: Sorrentino 2021 ageing hand PPS
citation: Sorrentino, G., Franza, M., Zuber, C., Blanke, O., Serino, A., & Bassolino, M. (2021). How ageing shapes body and space representations: A comparison study between healthy young and older adults. Cortex 136, 56–76.
notes: Timing inspection includes three paired delays, the three matched tactile-only delays and the 20 auditory-only catches.

reported_source.type: Looming broadband noise generated by two-speaker intensity changes.

reported_tactile_response.response: Press a pedal with the right foot within 2 s of touch. Ignore sound.

reference_parameters.analysis: Use the fastest of the three participant mean tactile-only reaction times as baseline. The deposited summaries support the hand-specific baseline reconstruction.
related_procedures: Body-landmark localization and avatar adjustment in the body representation assessments.
reference_parameters.inspection_scope: One 110-trial timing pool. No duplication across hands or trial spacing is assumed. Stationary white noise, software tactile marker and mouse response serve as inspection signals.
implementation_gaps: Original broadband audio, physical two-speaker gain trajectory and calibrated playback levels are unavailable.
Motor drive and coupling calibration, exact motor vibration frequency and pedal hardware timings are unresolved.
The trial count allocation between hands and inter-stimulus interval reference are unreported.
